title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: Latest Staff Engineer constraints override broad business wish list.
10 MB is a proposed prototype limit pending PM confirmation.
Model names, endpoint URLs, responses, and capability combinations are fixtures, not validated production support.
All upload, storage, ASR and inference operations are simulations; no files leave the browser.
ASR capability flag uses a checkbox in endpoint registration and a table action.
Persona catalog is absent from staged skill bundle; ai-developer is a source-derived role.
Endpoint choices are stored in sessionStorage solely to demonstrate navigation; chat persistence is out of scope.
limitations: Browser inspection unavailable; visual distinctness and interactive journeys need browser validation.
Local HTTP server blocked by environment socket permissions.
PatternFly CDN loading requires network access in the viewing browser.
